checker: Claude Opus 5.5, reading both diffs and the repository history
scope: the 26 pairs both judges called usable

pairs.reason: The culprit replaced a scan whose plain-struct fallback compared module_source with an index keyed by name alone; the dropped comparison is in the diff.
Backtracking and left-recursion handling for the SQLite grammar is a feature; the culprit's LL(k) dispatch was a limitation, not a regression.
The culprit moved the dump code out of wado-cli but switched it to a silent() host while keeping the map_err that drops the error.
The culprit wrote .tagpr with no [tagpr] section, and with `command` where `postVersionCommand` was meant.
The culprit removed the wall-clock timeout whose deleted comment said it guarded a frame_tx.send blocked on a stalled client.
The culprit left labeled breaks uncommitted, and its comment names the gap and the fix the fix PR made.
The culprit's can_move_past checks that the intervening statement does not clobber the moved expression, not the reverse.
The culprit decodes FNAME/FCOMMENT a byte per char while its compressor writes the string's UTF-8 bytes.
The culprit copied a grouping that skips names without a ' (-Ox)' suffix into a page whose names carry none.
When the culprit merged, `pub` meant package-internal visibility and its WEP said `is_pub` is never a root; a later visibility redesign made the bug.
The culprit, a lockfile chore, renamed the package, which changes the extension ID.
The culprit names the temp file by pid alone, so threads in one process share it; its comment covers processes only.
A cache miss from env differences; seeing it takes knowing sccache hashes every CARGO_* variable.
The culprit instantiates a dependency only when used, yet wires every provider and bails when none is wired.
The culprit's walk_and_delete propagates NotFound from a directory others may change.
The culprit's op-only walker emits `?` as a plain first-set `if`, while the surface walker beside it dispatches on the Optional strategy.
The culprit assumes an existing target/ is a build this session started, which is false in a resumed container; the effect is a cold build.
The culprit added the unrelated-aggregate cast check with holes; before it there was no check at all.
The rule-argument `[...]` regression came from 62da5e4b, which replaced the culprit's depth tracking.
The culprit drops self params from the names while a path-form call passes the receiver as args[0].
A spec-conformance sweep with several defects, some of them design choices that differ from TC39.
A spec-conformance sweep with several defects; the culprit moved part of the runtime from core:protobuf, so the i32 sizes predate it.
The culprit's block parser lets list markers, ref defs and HTML-like lines interrupt a paragraph, against CommonMark.
The culprit carried the confinement rule over from the value_copy_elide pass it deleted.
The culprit added call-inferred edges but let them yield when they close a cycle; before it, cycles through calls were not seen at all.
The culprit added the T::method argument check but skipped the receiver and type-param parameters; before it nothing was checked.
